clue.text: Lengthy spring athletics event

parts.note: lengthy means long, of great extent
to spring is to leap, so a spring is a leap or bound

explanation.surface: A track-and-field event involving a long, bounding leap.
explanation.definitionFit: This field contest, where competitors sprint and leap into a sandpit for distance, is an example of an athletics event.

clue.text: Name-tag

definitions.meaning: to name something is to call or designate it, as a verb
a tag is a small ticket fixed to an item giving information about it

explanation.definitionFit: To designate or call something is to give it this, and a sticker or ticket attached to goods is also this.

clue.text: Plant circles set outside

indicators.note: outside tells us the word for set goes round the outside of the word for circles

parts.note: to set, as a jelly does, is to gel
circles are rounds, as in rounds of drinks or laps

explanation.surface: A gardener describes a plant set inside a ring of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set' reads as a verb in the surface, but here it means to solidify, as a jelly does.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common yellow-flowered weed, a member of the daisy family, so it is a kind of plant.

clue.text: Speaker, one speaking in indistinct voice started late

indicators.note: a word that started late has lost its opening letter, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: someone who speaks indistinctly under the breath is a mutterer

explanation.surface: A speaker who mumbled their way into a speech after a late start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'started late' removes the M from the front of MUTTERER.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who voices words or sounds is a speaker of them, one who gives vocal expression.

clue.text: There isn't any comeback beyond it

definitions.text: There isn't any comeback beyond it

parts.words: There isn't any comeback beyond it
parts.note: reads like a remark about a debate with no reply possible, but describes the stage past which one cannot turn back or retreat

explanation.definitionFit: Once you pass this critical stage, retreat or reversal is impossible, so there is no coming back.

clue.text: Present vehicle, us railway wagon

parts.note: a Christmas box is a present, a gift given at Christmas to tradespeople
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A gift vehicle that turns out to be a model railway wagon from America.
explanation.walkthrough: A Christmas box is a traditional British tip or gift to tradespeople such as postal workers at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: In North America an enclosed freight wagon on the railways is called by this name.

clue.text: Two cleaning vessels put together to make third one

parts.note: a bath is one vessel you wash in
a tub is another vessel used for washing

explanation.surface: Two washing vessels are joined to form a third.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two cleaning vessels' gives both pieces, and the third vessel that they make is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The joined word is itself a further vessel for washing in, the third one the clue mentions.

clue.text: Account to study a-to-z on the return passage

parts.note: CA is an abbreviation for current account
a den is a private study or retreat

indicators.note: on the return means the letters are read backwards, coming back the other way

parts.note: a-to-z gives the letters A and Z

explanation.surface: Someone sends an account off to study an A-to-Z street atlas on the way back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the return' turns AZ into ZA. 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadenza is a showy solo section near the end of a concerto movement, so a musical passage.

clue.text: Day of joyful occurrence when final reminder arrives?

definitions.text: Day of joyful occurrence when final reminder arrives?

parts.words: Day of joyful occurrence when final reminder arrives?
parts.note: a day of happy celebration is named after the colour once used in calendars for festivals, while a last demand for an unpaid bill is traditionally printed in that same colour

explanation.definitionFit: A memorable happy day is a red-letter day, and an urgent final demand for payment is printed in red ink.

clue.text: But you arranged purchase of a controlling share

indicators.note: arranged signals that the letters of but you are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A complaint that someone arranged to take over a company.
explanation.definitionFit: When investors acquire enough stock to take control of a firm, that acquisition is called a takeover of this kind.

clue.text: Mean Edwin's fiancée

parts.note: to mean to do something is to intend it
Ed is a short form of the name Edwin

explanation.surface: A remark about the woman Edwin is engaged to.
explanation.definitionFit: One's future spouse is one's betrothed, so a fiancée is one's beloved-to-be.

clue.text: Left lady, about time, with falcon

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name, so a lady
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A woman abandoned, after a while, together with her bird of prey.
explanation.definitionFit: A lanneret is the male lanner, a type of falcon used in falconry.

clue.text: Leyton Orient winger's internal darting pain

indicators.note: internal signals that the letters sit inside the words Orient winger's

explanation.surface: A football winger at the London club Leyton Orient suffers an internal pain.
explanation.walkthrough: Leyton Orient is a football club in east London; the answer runs across the end of 'Orient' and into 'winger's'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden sharp stab or pang is what this word means, a darting pain.

clue.text: Printing type reproduced out of fairness

indicators.note: reproduced suggests the letters of fairness are made again in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A typeface reproduced out of a sense of fairness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' is a link meaning 'made from'.
explanation.definitionFit: A typeface without the small strokes at letter ends is a family of typefaces in printing.

clue.text: Sissy then moved building up

indicators.note: moved signals the letters of sissy then are moved about into another order

explanation.surface: A weakling then moved house to start bodybuilding.
explanation.definitionFit: Synthesis is the combining of parts into a whole, the process of building something up.

clue.text: Even a clean one should not be shown in the interests of decency

definitions.text: Even a clean one should not be shown in the interests of decency

parts.words: Even a clean one should not be shown in the interests of decency
parts.note: plays on the idiom of making a clean confession, while picturing a part of the body that modesty keeps covered

explanation.definitionFit: To make a clean breast of it is to confess fully, while modesty asks that this part of the chest stay covered.

clue.text: Gradual change, rebellion did not start

indicators.note: did not start means the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a rebellion is a revolution, an uprising

explanation.surface: Gradual change, unlike a revolt that never got going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'did not start' drops the R from REVOLUTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Evolution is development by slow stages, as in species altering over generations.

clue.text: Almost without sleep in the city

indicators.note: almost means the word is not quite complete, so its last letter is cut

parts.note: napless means without a nap, so without sleep

explanation.surface: A traveller nearly sleepless in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' drops the final S of NAPLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Naples is a large Italian port in Campania, so an example of a city.

clue.text: Nouveau-riche on equal footing with goddess for the most part

parts.note: on a par means on equal footing, giving par

indicators.note: for the most part means most of the word is used, so its last letter goes

parts.note: Venus is the Roman goddess of love

explanation.surface: A newly rich person thinks themselves on a par with a goddess, mostly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the most part' drops the S of VENUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A parvenu is an upstart who has recently gained wealth but lacks social standing, like the newly rich.

clue.text: Despicable individual as well in mediocre setting

indicators.note: in tells us the words for as well are placed inside another word
setting suggests a mount surrounding a jewel, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: so-so means mediocre, just average
and means as well, in addition

explanation.surface: A nasty person who also looks out of place in a second-rate setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' is a jeweller's mount, so it backs up 'in' by picturing one word holding the other like a stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a so-and-so is a mild euphemism for an unpleasant or contemptible person.

clue.text: Quick inspection having made single crossing

parts.note: once means one single time
over means across, as in crossing over something

explanation.surface: A quick check by someone who crossed only one time.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapid or cursory examination is given this informal name.

clue.text: Reach a certain speed when timer finished

parts.note: a clock is a timer
up means finished, as in time is up

explanation.surface: Reaching a target speed just as the stopwatch runs out.
explanation.definitionFit: To register or attain a speed or total, as on a speedometer, is to clock it up.

clue.text: I ran off after the man got a rupture

indicators.note: after tells us the mixed letters come after the word for the man

parts.note: he is the pronoun for the man

indicators.note: off signals the letters of I ran go wrong and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone ran off after a man who had suffered a rupture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ran off' reads as fled in the surface, but 'off' is the anagram signal working on I RAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A hernia is a protrusion of an organ through a weak spot in muscle, a medical rupture.

clue.text: Strongly expressive in a manner of speaking

definitions.text: Strongly expressive in a manner of speaking

parts.words: Strongly expressive in a manner of speaking
parts.note: the phrase looks like a hedge meaning roughly, but literally describes someone powerfully articulate in their speech

explanation.definitionFit: A fluent, persuasive speaker is one whose speech is forceful and moving.

clue.text: Sappers in the small group

indicators.note: in places the word for sappers within the word the

parts.note: the Royal Engineers, the British army's sappers, are abbreviated RE

explanation.surface: Army engineers belong to a little unit.
explanation.walkthrough: Sappers is a common nickname for the Royal Engineers of the British army.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a tiny band of people, so the number naming a trio stands for a small group.

clue.text: Asked hun to remove dagger

indicators.note: remove suggests the letters of asked hun are shifted out of place

explanation.surface: A barbarian warrior is asked to take away a dagger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link. A skean dhu is the small knife worn in the sock with Highland dress in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The skean dhu is a short Scottish knife, a type of dagger.

clue.text: No way asterisk was deployed for emperor

indicators.note: no tells us letters are taken away before the rest is mixed
was deployed suggests the remaining letters are spread out in a new order

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: An asterisk was not used for a footnote about an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: Take ST from ASTERISK to leave AERIK plus S, then 'was deployed' rearranges those six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Kaiser was the title of the German emperor, derived from Caesar.

clue.text: Boss had one circular room

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob or ornament
I is the Roman numeral for one
O is a circular letter

explanation.surface: The boss owned a single round room.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio is an artist's or broadcaster's workroom, so a kind of room.

clue.text: The north-eastern enclosure first has pitcher-plant

indicators.note: first tells us the letters for north-eastern enclosure come before the word the

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A north-eastern garden enclosure holds a carnivorous plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' puts NE and PEN ahead of THE. Nepenthes is the genus of tropical pitcher plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepenthes is the botanical genus of tropical carnivorous plants that trap insects in jug-shaped leaves.
